links.comparator_used: hand-crafted scalar NR-IQA metrics (BRISQUE, NIQE, PIQE, SNR, PSNR) as quality gates; device-reported quality scores are cited as unreliable but not tested
links.outcome: Ability of the quality gate to predict whether a B-scan will yield a reliable choroid segmentation (ROC-AUC, correlation)
links.effect: Scalar NR-IQA metrics: |r| < 0.20. ImageNet-pretrained representations: ROC-AUC up to 0.77. RETFound (OCT-specific foundation model): ROC-AUC ≈ 0.81.
links.quote: General-purpose ImageNet-based pretrained representations (EfficientNet-b0, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16) improve upon NR-IQA, achieving ROC-AUC up to 0.77, indicating that learned representations are better suited to task-specific quality gating than hand-crafted scalar statistics.
